local_source: User photograph, Actualización del catálogo de la flora vascular silvestre de La Rioja, catálogo florístico, ASPLENIACEAE complete block
local_note: The printed source states for Asplenium trichomanes subsp. trichomanes: no se tienen pruebas definitivas de su presencia en La Rioja.

national_pattern_exact_hybrid_search.interpretation: No exact hybrid-form Asplenium names found in the searched national pattern canonical-name column; this is not proof that the hybrids are taxonomically invalid.

current_official_taxonomic_check.source: Plants of the World Online / WCVP, Kew, 2026
current_official_taxonomic_check.distribution_note: Taxonomic acceptance does not by itself establish presence in La Rioja.

implementation_finding.mechanism: The static-source canonical reconstruction uses genus/specificEpithet and can drop the hybrid marker from scientificName. Therefore an active target written as 'Genus x epithet' can be falsely classified as NO_RESPONSE_ALL_THREE even when the official source carries 'Genus × epithet'.
implementation_finding.impact: The five Asplenium review rows are not reliable evidence of taxonomic non-response. Other hybrid-form review rows may be affected globally.
implementation_finding.repair: TAXONOMIC_REALITY_EFFECTIVE_2739_V8_HYBRID_AWARE triggered; v7 preserved as historical evidence.

decision.reason: The local complete Rioja catalogue does not list these five hybrid names, while POWO/WCVP recognizes them taxonomically. Do not convert either fact into silent deletion or a Rioja-presence assertion.

guards: Taxonomic validity is distinct from presence in La Rioja.
Absence from the local catalogue is preserved as local-source negative evidence, not as global taxonomic invalidity.
POWO/WCVP acceptance is not used to infer Rioja occurrence.
v7 no-response for hybrid-form names is superseded for exact-matching interpretation by the hybrid-marker defect finding.
No active-universe deletion or replacement is authorized from this reconciliation alone.
next_step: Run and inspect v8 hybrid-aware full-universe audit before selecting the next anomaly queue.
